description: This file defines the Media plugin class for CKEditor 5 integration within Drupal, providing media element handling, view mode configuration, and plugin settings.

classes.name: Media
classes.description: A CKEditor 5 plugin class for handling media elements, view modes, and plugin configuration within Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the plugin with configuration, plugin ID, plugin definition, and entity display repository.

methods.name: configureViewModes
methods.description: Configures allowed view modes, style configurations, and toolbar options for media elements based on the editor's filter and display settings.

methods.name: getDynamicPluginConfig
methods.description: Generates dynamic plugin configuration including preview URL, view modes, metadata URL, and CSRF token for media.

methods.name: getElementsSubset
methods.description: Returns a subset of plugin elements, optionally excluding the view mode element if override is disabled.

methods.name: defaultConfiguration
methods.description: Provides default configuration for the plugin, specifically disabling view mode override.

methods.name: buildConfigurationForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form allowing users to enable or disable view mode override.

methods.name: validateConfigurationForm
methods.description: Validates and casts the view mode override form input to boolean.

methods.name: submitConfigurationForm
methods.description: Saves the view mode override setting from the form into plugin configuration.
